item_name: Rothco G.I. Style Medical Kit Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco's Medical Kit Bag is designed to keep your first aid and medical supplies organized and accessible. Constructed from durable polyester, this bag is built for lasting use in various conditions. It features 3 zippered compartments, providing ample storage space to neatly organize your essentials. The adjustable shoulder strap ensures a comfortable and customizable carrying experience, whether you're on the move or need to keep your supplies close at hand.
